chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:

The greatest regret on the Day of Resurrection will be the regret of a man who earned wealth not in obedience to Allah, so a man inherited it and spent it in obedience to Allah, the Glorified, and he entered Paradise because of it, while the first man entered the Fire because of it.
ai.seo_question: What is the greatest regret on the Day of Judgment according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) highlights the profound disparity in divine accounting, where the source of wealth determines its eternal reward or punishment. This narration underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on *khulus* (purity of intention) and the spiritual impurity of ill-gotten gains, illustrating how the same material resource can yield Paradise for the spender but Hell for the sinner who earned it. It serves as a cautionary tale on the lasting consequences of accumulating wealth through disobedience to God.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 429. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:

On the Day of Judgement the greatest regret will be felt by the man who earned wealth through sinful ways, although it is inherited by a person who spends it in obeying Allāh, the Glorified, and he will be awarded Paradise on that account while the first one will go into the Fire on account of it.
